text:
emma_prod: Quick sync: drafting a staged rollout for priority-tenant routing (premium tenants to faster pools). Need gating metrics, customer opt-in plan, and emergency controls. Thoughts?

ryan_eng: Sounds good. Strong preference for tenant-based canary vs request-sampling. Start with 2 manual pilot tenants, then 2% tenant slice.

jules_sre: Agree. Operational gates: tenant p95 delta, pool queued_requests, and 5xx rate. If any gate trips -> router should auto-fallback that tenant.

priya_data: For experiments, we'll do matched cohorts and report paired p95 and cost deltas. Need events: route.variant, fallback_reason, request_id. I'll template dashboards.

lena_cs: Two customers asked for early access. They want a Console toggle and an easy revert. Also want a short FAQ for Beta.

ryan_eng: Rollout stages proposal:
1) staging smoke tests (no tenants)
2) 2 pilot tenants (manual opt-in) for 24h
3) 2% tenant slice canary for 72h with telemetry gating
4) ramp to 20% over 7 days if stable
5) GA opt-in in Console + API

jules_sre: Router fallback rules (enforced):
- If tenant p95 > baseline + 20ms for 1m -> route tenant to fallback pool
- If pool cpu/gpu > 90% or OOM -> fallback region-wide
- If a tenant has >3 fallbacks in 1h -> disable flag and page owners

ryan_eng: Feature flag sample (flat JSON):
`{"name":"routing.priority.v1","variants":["default","fastpool"],"pilots":["internal","pilot-a"],"percent":2,"gates":{"p95_delta_ms":20,"error_rate_pct":0.5},"kill_switch":true}`

priya_data: Metrics to monitor: primary = tenant p95 change and 5xx delta; secondary = pool utilization, mean queue time, token cost change. We'll compute tenant-relative baselines.

lena_cs: Comms: draft pilot invite + FAQ. We need Legal blurb that beta may change response latencies but not contract SLAs.

jules_sre: Ops checklist before tenant slice:
- Dashboards: per-tenant p50/p95/p99 + fallback_count
- Alerts: p95 delta -> P0 and auto-fallback
- Reserve 10% spare capacity in fast pools
- Runbook: manual removal of tenant from fast pool

ryan_eng: Devex: API example to flip flag:
`PATCH /admin/tenant/{id}/flags body: {"routing.priority.v1":"fastpool"}`
Devbot: deploy queued for flag infra update (deploy-5001) :rocket:

jules_sre: Also require global emergency kill switch in Console that forces all tenants to default and emits audit event + pages SRE.

priya_data: Experiment analysis plan: quick 24h check, full 72h paired report, and a summary at 20% ramp. Use bootstrap CIs for p95.

lena_cs: I'll coordinate pilot customers and ensure UX includes revert button.

emma_prod: Action items: Ryan -> infra + feature flag; Priya -> dashboards + experiment plan; Jules -> runbook + alerts; Lena -> comms + pilot onboarding. Target: staging next week, pilots in two weeks.

devbot: deploy success: flag infra update live in staging (deploy-5001)

emma_prod: Thanks all — keeping thread open for signoffs.
